title: Odile and the Postcard
author: S. M. Underhill
blurb: Tamsin Nystrom, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the bakery lease runs out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
